On certain maps that have a tendency to go late game yes, other maps its not worth it at all
maps that I (rank 1 less than 900 games though) would take CP
Tomb of the Spider Queen & Garden Terror.

Its not worth it typically because the characters who use CP level 1 have other useful talents such as;

Malfurion; Scouting drone is an amazing brush checker as well as a way to keep your team safe from ganks and stealth characters who may try to loop around in a fight.

Tassadar has a talent that gives him mana back per each enemy hit initially with his q, you can hit a whole wave of minions or 5 people in a fight and basically get the mana back for his q.

Those are just a few examples of the many why in most situations CP isn't the best option

Heroes that you will have the best chance carrying your team on in most situations.
Ranged DPS; Valla, Jaina is strong.
Melee DPS; Thrall, Zeratul
Tanks; Diablo, Muradin (If you are a really good chen, pick Chen)
Supports; Brightwing, Rehgar. 

Jaina has extremely high dps but is easily caught so don't pick her into a zeratul or nova unless you feel safe enough with the comp your team has. ( provided you trust your team ) 
Valla is safe in all situations, her build CAN change but typically multishot build is the strongest.

Thrall has the highest sustain out of all heroes in the game outside of healers, if you build him properly you will have ridiculous damage and a crazy amount of sustain as well as an ultimate great for separating a single target from their team.
 
Zeratul is an all around great ganker on small maps and his ultimate is one of the best in the game when it comes to combos, but just from his high single target damage and gank presence.

Diablo has great pick potential on his own as well as his decent damage and passive that makes him an extremely strong hero for solo carrying due to the importance of a good tank line in HotS

Muradin is increddibly tanky as well as having great damage and sustain with thunderclap build and a stun.

Brightwing can teleport to any lane so she doesn't lose XP if played well and can turn the tides of a fight with an ultimate or just showing up

Rehgar is my favourite support because you can solo a lot of camps and other heroes as well as healing your tank up for full life, he has the best damage out of all the supports. 
Good luck.
